entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.note: Definition of 'drug' read in Article 1 of Directive (EU) 2017/2103 as published on legislation.gov.uk (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eudr/2017/2103/article/1/data.html); title and date of the Framework Decision from the EUDA Drugs Library entry. The EUR-Lex consolidated text (version of 2021-06-09) could not be read from this environment. This row is the same for every substance; none of the substances named on this page is in the Framework Decision's Annex (substances brought under EU-wide control) as read on 2026-10-16: the Annex as inserted by Directive (EU) 2017/2103, the additions of 2019 to 2022 listed in the Commission's report COM(2022) 251 (with Delegated Directive (EU) 2022/1326), and Delegated Directive (EU) 2025/2062.
